parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: The handle of the bucket is a curved steel rod with a plastic grip section, designed for carrying the bucket.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to lift and carry the bucket comfortably, distributing the weight evenly.
parts.Movement_description: The handle can rotate around its attachment points on the bucket body, allowing it to swing freely for carrying or resting.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main cylindrical container of the bucket, made of durable polypropylene plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It holds liquids or solids, providing the main storage capacity of the bucket.
parts.Movement_description: The base body is a fixed, rigid structure that does not move independently; it supports the handle and contains the contents.
